summary: Completed full testing of Phase 1 Loan Detail + EMI Ledger Page. All 9 backend API tests passed. All 14 frontend features verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data - HDFC Home Loan ID: 886f8ea0-1f10-4a3e-8280-eefc1567bc5e
context_for_next_testing_agent: Loan Detail page (Phase 1) fully tested at /wealth/loans/:id. HDFC Home Loan has 147 EMIs after testing (4 paid, 68 missed, 75 pending). Extra payments recorded in loan_extra_payments collection. Mark EMI functionality creates emi_transactions entries.

navigate_myloans_to_loan_detail.details: Clicking loan card navigates to /wealth/loans/:id (not /loan/:id). HDFC Home Loan card navigates correctly.

loan_detail_page_renders.details: Page renders at /wealth/loans/886f8ea0-1f10-4a3e-8280-eefc1567bc5e with loan name 'HDFC Home Loan', type 'Home Loan', outstanding ₹41,21,978, interest rate 8.5%, EMI ₹45,329, tenure 147 mo.

emi_ledger_color_coded_statuses.details: EMI Ledger displays entries with Green=Paid (checkmark icon), Red=Missed (X icon), Amber/Orange=Pending (clock icon). Status buttons are clickable for missed/pending EMIs.

emi_progress_section.details: EMI Progress section shows counts: 4 Paid (green), 68 Missed (red), 75 Pending (amber). Counts update after mark-emi operations.

mark_emi_as_paid.details: Clicking missed/pending EMI status button marks it as paid. Toast shows 'EMI #4 marked as paid'. Outstanding reduces and page refreshes with updated data.

extra_payment_modal.details: Extra Payment button opens modal with Amount input field and Impact Mode selector (Reduce Tenure / Reduce EMI buttons). Current outstanding shown in modal.

submit_extra_payment.details: Submitting extra payment (₹10,000) reduces outstanding from ₹41,31,978 to ₹41,21,978. Toast shows 'Extra payment of ₹10,000 applied!'

loan_insights_section.details: Loan Insights shows: Total Interest Payable (₹16,63,306), Interest Paid So Far (₹1,18,306), Interest Saved from Extra Payments (₹1,360), EMI-to-Income 6.8%, Safety Impact Days (3 days).

edit_button_navigation.details: Edit button navigates to /loan/:id (LoanForm component). Form shows 'Edit Loan' title with pre-filled data.

back_button_navigation.details: Back button navigates to /my-loans page correctly.

view_all_toggle.details: Toggle button shows 'View All (147)' in condensed view, changes to 'Show Less' when expanded. Scrollable table shows all EMIs when expanded.

get_amortization_api.details: GET /api/loans/:id/amortization returns full schedule with 147 entries, summary with paidEMIs/missedEMIs/pendingEMIs counts, and extraPayments array.

post_extra_payment_api.details: POST /api/loans/:id/extra-payment correctly reduces outstanding and records payment in loan_extra_payments collection. Supports both reduce_tenure and reduce_emi modes.

post_mark_emi_api.details: POST /api/loans/:id/mark-emi creates emi_transaction entry with emiNo, principal/interest breakdown, and updates loan outstanding.

backend_tests_summary.test_amortization_summary_counts: PASS - Summary has paid/missed/pending counts that add up correctly
backend_tests_summary.test_amortization_status_values: PASS - All entries have valid status (paid/missed/pending)

backend_tests_summary.test_extra_payment_reduce_tenure: PASS - Outstanding reduced by payment amount
